source.note: The archives were packed from this tree: the version commit 83d6c3a3, the release build's regenerated notices (de023dd0), and the template declaring pixi.js and @pixi/react (1dd3af21), which the packed-import check found its main.ts importing undeclared. All three are on main.

publication: All seventeen versions are live: every registry shasum matches its tested archive and every tarball downloaded with no credentials is byte-identical to it. @volter/blender-engine 0.1.9 is unchanged and was not republished (the repacked archive has the registry's shasum). @volter/model-editor 0.5.68 was held by the registry as a staged version for about an hour (a republish answered 409 "previously staged version"; npm stage list showed nothing to approve), then went live without approval, as 0.5.67 did.

checks.packedImports: 1172 files across 8 packages (modeling); 2330 files across 17 packages (game), after the template declared pixi.js and @pixi/react
checks.servedModules: served-bundle table matches the template and catalog (18 packages); runtime image carries every template and catalog dependency (38)

packedAcceptance.game: Runtime image installed from the seventeen archives with no workspace links; create linked it; a fresh empty game took add music, opened a piece with two launcher scenes, launched Combat (its three slots playing; strip meters Pad -26.2, Bass -20.3, Drums -18.6 dBFS, Lead -inf), rendered through project.music.render (23 files including both scene loops, no problems, -18 LUFS, each recorded in .volter/provenance.json), and an added scene undid byte-identically; console silent.
packedAcceptance.modeling: The eight archives installed with no links; a model project from the packed product opened cube.blend; a Blender edit moved Cube to x=1.5, undo returned it to 0 and redo to 1.5; console silent.

installation.path: npx -y @volter/game-editor@0.5.68 create reg-game installed the runtime image from the registry, downloaded the pinned game workbench anonymously, and started a session; add music, the two-scene piece, a scene launch metered as in packed acceptance, a render through the tool with its scene loops and provenance, and an added scene with undo all worked from that install.

audit: The model editor installs with 0 vulnerabilities. The game runtime image reports 8 (5 low, 3 moderate), all through colyseus -> @colyseus/auth -> grant/request-oauth (uuid, elliptic via jwk-to-pem); no upstream fix exists.
limitations: See WORK.md for the game editor's remaining list.
